title: The Impossible Plan — Episode 1
notes: Original fictional heist parody. Keep character IDs and their visual definitions stable across episodes.

scenes.action: The Planner taps a wall map and reveals a plan with too many arrows.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Tonight, we perform the cleanest operation in history. Rookie: Great. Is there a checklist?
scenes.caption: THE IMPOSSIBLE PLAN

scenes.action: Rookie proudly turns the map upside down and points at the ceiling.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Why is the map upside down? Rookie: The guards will never expect it.
scenes.caption: GENIUS OR TOTAL DISASTER?

scenes.action: Pixel lights up a monitor wall and types a dramatic password.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: I secured the system with a password nobody can guess. Planner: What is it? Pixel: Password123.
scenes.caption: CYBERSECURITY: QUESTIONABLE

scenes.action: The team studies a tiny floor plan while Rookie holds it backwards.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Memorise every corridor. Rookie: I have memorised the back of the paper.
scenes.caption: DETAILS MATTER

scenes.action: Rookie climbs into a delivery van and waves at an imaginary audience.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: You are supposed to look ordinary. Rookie: I am being aggressively ordinary.
scenes.caption: STEALTH MODE: ACTIVATED

scenes.action: Rookie tiptoes past Captain Vale, then waves with both hands.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Do I know you? Rookie: Not yet. Nice to meet you.
scenes.caption: INVISIBLE. BASICALLY.

scenes.action: The Planner hands Rookie a tiny earpiece that is visibly too large.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Follow my instructions exactly. Rookie: Can you repeat that in simpler instructions?
scenes.caption: ONE JOB. ONE EARPIECE.

scenes.action: Rookie sneaks toward the entrance but stops to tie a shoelace for ages.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Why are you crouching? Rookie: The floor looked suspicious.
scenes.caption: SUSPICIOUS FLOOR DETECTED

scenes.action: The team arrives at a grand fictional bank entrance. Rookie presses the doorbell.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: That was not the signal. Rookie: But it made a very confident beep.
scenes.caption: THE PLAN HAS LEFT THE CHAT

scenes.action: Captain Vale checks a clipboard while Rookie pretends to be a delivery worker.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Delivery for whom? Rookie: For... the building. Everyone in it.
scenes.caption: DELIVERY: ONE AWKWARD MOMENT

scenes.action: Pixel watches a countdown timer and spins dramatically in a chair.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: I have ten minutes to open the route. Planner: We have nine. Pixel: Then I will type faster.
scenes.caption: THE CLOCK IS TICKING

scenes.action: Rookie presents an empty clipboard as if it contains important paperwork.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: There is nothing on this page. Rookie: It is a minimalist document.
scenes.caption: PAPERWORK IS POWER

scenes.action: The Planner and Pixel face a giant vault wheel and study its markings.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Quiet, careful, precise. Pixel: I brought a very loud wrench.
scenes.caption: THE VAULT PROBLEM

scenes.action: Rookie gently knocks on the vault door and waits for an answer.
scenes.dialogue: Rookie: Hello? Is anybody in there? Planner: It is a vault, not a neighbour.
scenes.caption: KNOCK KNOCK. NO REPLY.

scenes.action: Pixel points at a blinking red button while Rookie leans closer.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: Whatever you do, do not press the red button. Rookie: Which red button?
scenes.caption: NEVER SAY THAT TO ROOKIE

scenes.action: A warning light flashes after Rookie presses the red button with one finger.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: You pressed it! Rookie: I was checking if it was real.
scenes.caption: ALARM: ROOKIE CONFIRMED

scenes.action: Captain Vale hears an alarm and turns sharply toward the corridor.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Why is the alarm going off? Rookie: It is celebrating our teamwork.
scenes.caption: THE BUILDING IS NOT CELEBRATING

scenes.action: The Planner calmly steps into view while Rookie tries to hide behind a tiny plant.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: We can explain everything. Captain Vale: Start with the plant.
scenes.caption: HIDE AND SEEK: FAILED

scenes.action: The team makes a fast dash down the street as Captain Vale follows.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Move, move, move! Rookie: I am moving emotionally and physically!
scenes.caption: PLAN B: RUN

scenes.action: Rookie slips on a loose paper and lands in a harmless cartoon pose.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Stop right there! Rookie: I would, but the ground has stopped me.
scenes.caption: THE GREAT GETAWAY WOBBLE

scenes.action: The team piles into the van, but the side door refuses to close.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: Is everyone in? Rookie: My elbow is still in the city.
scenes.caption: EXIT STRATEGY: NEEDS WORK

scenes.action: Pixel studies a navigation screen that shows a route shaped like a question mark.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Where does that road lead? Pixel: Technically, toward a road.
scenes.caption: GPS: GOOD LUCK

scenes.action: The Planner and Rookie pause on a rooftop and watch distant city lights.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: We need to think clearly. Rookie: I have been thinking loudly all day.
scenes.caption: A MOMENT OF REGRET

scenes.action: Pixel arrives holding a snack bag while Rookie gives a dramatic thumbs-up.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: I saved the most important supplies. Rookie: Snacks? Pixel: Exactly.
scenes.caption: PRIORITIES RESTORED

scenes.action: Back at the safehouse, the team reviews a report full of red circles.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: The plan failed at step one. Rookie: So step two is still fresh!
scenes.caption: POST-MISSION REVIEW

scenes.action: The Planner draws a new arrow on the map while Rookie watches carefully.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Next time, listen before acting. Rookie: I can do one of those things.
scenes.caption: LESSONS WERE ALMOST LEARNED

scenes.action: Pixel reveals a tiny backup plan hidden behind a monitor.
scenes.dialogue: Pixel: Good news, I prepared a backup. Planner: Is it better? Pixel: It has fewer buttons.
scenes.caption: BACKUP PLAN: SLIGHTLY BETTER

scenes.action: Captain Vale arrives at the safehouse doorway holding the team's upside-down map.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: You dropped this. Planner: You followed us here? Captain Vale: The map had your address.
scenes.caption: THE MAP BETRAYED EVERYONE

scenes.action: Everyone sits around the table while Rookie raises a hand to ask a question.
scenes.dialogue: Rookie: Did we win? Captain Vale: Nobody won. Pixel: But we learned about passwords.
scenes.caption: THE MOST CONFUSING TEAM-UP

scenes.action: The team poses for a group photo as the Planner quietly turns the map the right way up.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: Tomorrow, we start again. Rookie: Upside down? Planner: Absolutely not.
scenes.caption: TO BE CONTINUED... MAYBE
